what: node_classes/host-seam.json carries NO workflow_versions. Decide its workflow — or decide it does not get one, and say what that means.
why_it_needs_adjudication: No workflow_versions. A host-seam's implementation lives where git cannot see it and its seal EXPIRES (the host drifts with nothing in git changing), so its workflow is probably not code-seam's — it likely needs a re-VERIFY rest that can go stale, which no existing class has. That is a design question, not a copy job.
blocks: any node cast as host-seam can never validate a workflow string; the class is unusable as physics.
source: node_classes/host-seam.json; measured 2026-08-02 (3 of 5 classes absent: concept-piece, host-seam, operational-driver)

resolved.ruling: Akien, 2026-08-03: 'workflow versions would be meaningless. a workflow is composed at ticketing time by the ticketer based on the needs of the ticket.'
resolved.became: TICKET — the-workflow-belongs-to-the-instance (consequence), plus the taxonomy node cast the same turn; NOT a workflow for this class.
resolved.note: Akien on this class: 'i have no idea.' NB it is not an orphan — it is named in CLAUDE.md's 'Which root?' partition and its why records his own 2026-07-22 words. Owner-does-not-recognize-it is its own finding, carried out of this item.
resolved.cc_read_of_the_consequence: CC's read of the consequence, NOT ruled: this does not merely fill three empty cells — it relocates the workflow from the CLASS to the INSTANCE. cairn/base/transitions.py::_registered_workflow refuses any version a class does not define, and _conform requires the node's path to MATCH the class-registered path exactly (free_summons aside). Under this ruling both are validating against the wrong owner: there is no class-level path for a ticketer-composed workflow to conform to. code-seam and skill still carry workflow_versions v1/v2, so the change is not a no-op for them either. What the class plausibly still owns is the CONSTRAINTS (which summonses are gates that may not be skipped) — that preserves the original why (a string cannot quietly skip PROVEME) while letting the ticketer compose the path. That reconciliation is a design detail for the corpus, not another question for Akien; it is carried into the consequence ticket, not settled here.
